about: Lays a page out: a banner, a header with everything that names the page, a navigation, a body and a footer.

align.about: The bands starting at the gutter, and the bands centred in the measure.
align.title: Alignment

divided.about: The header ruled off from the body, beside a page left whole.
divided.title: Divided

folded.about: Where the line of meta beside the title goes. Unfolded it shares the title’s row; folded it takes a row of its own under the title, which is what a narrow page needs once the actions have taken the room.
folded.title: Folded header

gutter.about: Every gutter, which every band reads.
gutter.title: Gutters

measure.about: Every measure the bands hold their contents to.
measure.title: Measures

size.about: Every size, which sets the title one heading step above a section's at the same size.
size.title: Sizes

title: Page
